verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI model or assistant product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of a self-hostable deployment, downloadable weights or an on-prem option. Instead it describes Grok as a hosted service: data is stored on xAI's servers, Grok Bot runs on a cloud computer, and custom MCP connectors require Grok's servers to reach your server over the public internet.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
